title: 2015-05 — John B. Thompson Granada Presbyterian Church / South Florida Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC found the BCO 40-5 application administratively out of order under OMSJC 9.1.a. and dismissed it as prematurely filed with the SJC. Because South Florida Presbytery had docketed the matter for its August 11, 2015 meeting and had not yet ruled, BCO 40-5 first required citing the offending court before the court of appellate jurisdiction rather than the SJC. No merits ruling was made on the discipline allegations.
first_summary: John B. Thompson’s BCO 40-5 application to cite Granada Presbyterian Church for alleged grossly unconstitutional proceedings and discipline delinquencies was dismissed as premature. South Florida Presbytery had docketed the matter and had not yet ruled, and BCO 40-5 required the first step to be a citation before the court of appellate jurisdiction.
summary: A BCO 40-5 application to cite Granada Presbyterian Church for alleged grossly unconstitutional proceedings and discipline delinquencies was found administratively out of order and dismissed as prematurely filed. The SJC held that, even assuming a credible report, BCO 40-5 first required citing the offending court before South Florida Presbytery, the court of appellate jurisdiction. Because Presbytery had docketed the matter for its August 11, 2015 meeting and had not yet ruled, the SJC could not act. No merits ruling on the discipline allegations was made.
